pressed_back_profile.method: Pose-independent posterior envelope from original45 source skin only. Domain uses sourceZ<=actual neutralSpine1headZ. Source cross-sections are separated by >15mm gaps in sorted sourceZ; within each cross-section select greatest sourceY separately on negative/positiveX. Average bilateral ridgeY/Z to define piecewise-linear sourceY envelope; end slopes extrapolate <6mm at domain ends. Expected groove depth=max(0,envelopeY(sourceZ)-sourceY), with selected direct ridge support points fixed to0. No posed coordinates enter selection/profile.
pressed_back_profile.prior_flat_midline19_test_preserved: Original criterion required flattening natural source centerline groove1.6–18.94mm and included7 original45 points above neutralSpine1headZ1.200m. Original raw45 and failed-flat19 statistics remain diagnostic; threshold magnitudes2/5mm stay unchanged.
